title: Pink_Ball_Winks
style: Contemporary Pop with Funk and Hip-Hop influences. Features a prominent, syncopated electric bassline, crisp electronic drum kit with a tight snare and punchy kick, and bright, rhythmic electric guitar scratches. A clean, percussive synth pluck provides melodic accents. Vocals are a mix of rhythmic rap-style delivery in the verses and melodic, layered pop vocals in the choruses. The arrangement uses frequent stop-starts and rhythmic gaps for dynamic contrast. Key of G Major, 115 BPM.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[tight electronic drums, syncopated bass, rhythmic synth pluck]

[Verse 1]
[rhythmic male vocals]
D-D-D-DJ Sin Rose
Pink, dink, dink
DJ Sin Rose
Pink wing petals
3-3-6
Corey
I, I, I
I, Din, Leo
Cynthio
Raffa-raps it back, spinnin' every track
Gravy's with the band, we got that Nick-a-sound

[Chorus]
[layered melodic vocals, driving bassline]
Pink ball wings, pink ball wings
Pink ball wings, all the same are one
Pink ball wings, pink ball wings
Pink ball wings, pickleball is me

[Verse 2]
[rap-style delivery]
Mishi-mish-mashing, pickleball and mishi
Are the same are one, mishi-mash win
Pink ball wings, pink ball wings
Corey paddles it back, rivers mirrors guide the way
Sneaky funk panda-dust, sneaky sound processor
Corey AI, Dick-a-dip-mid-row
My avatar talks back, tells me what to wear
Pick a black-a hat or a grim with pickle flare
Custom outfit clean, fresh on the wink-wink-wink
When I walk in for sports, bright blue pickle socks
Pink drink pickle hat I got it like that
Found my feet, found my feet on the painted line
Hear that little click, now I'm right on time
That switch it hard, now my hole's like my car

[Chorus]
[full arrangement]
Pickleball is me, pickleball is me
I am one with the ball, I am one with the ball
You want it, I got it, you want it, I got it
We together are one, we together are one

[Bridge]
[percussive synth, bass-heavy groove]
Best paddle in my hand from the riddle I cracked
Pick a pig paddle now I don't look back
Pickleball dinks, sweetest way, nice play
Pink ball wings, every step on the court
Got a say in my day on the split no scene
Synchronization matrix upgrade complete
Found my feet, found my feet on the painted line
Hear that little click, now I'm right on time
That switch it hard, now my hole's like my car
Talk to me avatar, what you got to say
He said stay low, stay loose and let the joy sink in
